findings.problem: 중립 audit/provenance graph와 agent가 조회·강제받는 active graph treatment가 분리되지 않았고, 현재 treatment는 graph를 optional로 둔다.
findings.impact: 통합 graph-control package의 효과를 추정하거나 이후 prototype에서 무엇을 채택할지 결정할 수 없다.
findings.revision: 공통 Prime/Pi·source/discovery·ORX·model/tool·assessor substrate를 고정하고 ACTIVE_EVIDENCE_GRAPH_CONTROL minus STRONG_SOURCE_BACKED_TREE_WITH_COMPULSORY_CHECKLIST를 유일한 primary contrast로 등록한다. 보이지 않는 audit graph는 양 arm을 동일하게 계측한다.
findings.closure_evidence: Hash-bound arm-difference table, action/prompt diff, graph visibility 및 contamination rule, protocol-deviation을 포함한 ITT plan.

findings.problem: Task suite, metric, invalid handling, final selection, confirmatory n/power/MUE, budget와 command가 비어 있고 certified task와 efficacy result가 0이다.
findings.impact: Schema/graph 진단이나 per-task archive maximum이 실제 독립 연구 성과를 대체하고 사후 endpoint 선택이 가능하다.
findings.revision: 하나의 coherent public small-compute ML family bundle을 택하고 campaign 종료 전 단일 artifact ID를 봉인한다. 숨겨진 test/scorer의 사전 지정 성능만 primary로 두며 crash·budget exhaustion·무산출물 floor를 고정한다.
findings.closure_evidence: License/ancestry/split/scorer certification, hidden isolation, immutable artifact-selection receipt, metric formula와 MUE.

findings.problem: 독립 programme/source-family 수와 stochastic noise 추정이 없고 confirmatory n, power, MUE가 null이다.
findings.impact: Seeds, candidates, rounds, checkpoints를 pseudo-replicates로 세거나 작은 noisy effect를 확정할 위험이 있다.
findings.revision: 최소 6 ancestry-disjoint dev families에서 tree/graph x passive/compulsory 2x2 pilot과 arm-family당 2 nested starts를 수행한다. Pilot variance로 80% power/95% interval 기준 n을 정하되 held-out family 계획 하한은 24이고, 계산된 n이 예산을 넘으면 claim을 축소한다.
findings.closure_evidence: Blinded power worksheet, ancestry cluster audit, randomized order, family-level paired analysis와 nested-repeat variance.

findings.problem: 최종 한 artifact가 아닌 archive maximum, official trajectory 밖 실패, creator/critic 비용 누락을 허용할 여지가 있다.
findings.impact: 추가 검색·평가 기회와 분모 삭제가 graph 효과 및 비용 효율로 오인될 수 있다.
findings.revision: Eligible-to-hidden-scored 전체 population flow를 보존하고 assigned campaign ITT를 쓴다. Token/cache, search, tools, all descendants, compute, evaluation, recovery, failure/retry, wall time을 equal hard ceiling 아래 모두 센다.
findings.closure_evidence: Randomized census와 artifact ledger 일치, 모든 실패 유형/비용 재계산, primary에서 best checkpoint/archive maximum 배제 audit.

findings.problem: C64가 보여 준 task-text 대 oracle semantic conflict와 ancestry-level development leakage를 새 confirmatory protocol이 아직 닫지 않았다.
findings.impact: Deterministic scorer가 틀린 의미를 정확히 채점하거나 treatment-shaped gold가 graph에 유리한 결론을 만들 수 있다.
findings.revision: Dev/confirmation을 dataset·repository·generator ancestry로 분리하고 task/source/metric/gold/prompt/schema/baseline adaptation을 dev 종료 시 봉인한다. 별도 semantic adjudicator가 edge-local/global 및 alternative-valid-action falsifier를 model run 전 확인한다.
findings.closure_evidence: Independent semantic receipt, source-to-gold locators, actual runner isolation, zero hidden access, hidden-open 후 변경 0건.

strongest_alternate_explanation: 관측 이점은 graph semantics가 아니라 더 많은 attention/active-view bytes, mandatory review, candidate/scorer opportunities 또는 treatment-shaped gold에서 생긴다. 동일 facts/opportunities/ceilings, evidence-consumption log, tree+compulsory-control comparator와 passive-graph ablation으로 이를 판별해야 한다.

decisive_experiment.estimand: At fixed budget B, mean family-level paired difference in hidden performance of one preselected final artifact: ACTIVE_EVIDENCE_GRAPH_CONTROL minus STRONG_SOURCE_BACKED_TREE_WITH_COMPULSORY_CHECKLIST.
decisive_experiment.pilot: At least 6 ancestry-disjoint development families; 2x2 tree/graph x passive/compulsory control; two nested independent starts per arm-family; used only for manipulation, contamination, failure, variance, MUE and cost planning.
decisive_experiment.confirmation: Pilot-powered, no fewer than 24 ancestry-disjoint held-out families, paired randomized order, two nested starts per arm-family, one frozen artifact before hidden scoring, one primary contrast.
decisive_experiment.analysis: Aggregate repeats within family, estimate family-level paired differences with a cluster/bootstrap or randomization interval, retain all assigned failures by frozen ITT rule, report quality-cost curve separately.
decisive_experiment.decision_rule: Adopt graph as prototype default only if preregistered MUE and interval criterion pass without safety/cost ceiling violation. Otherwise choose the strong tree; null or negative is a valid research result. Cost-superiority rescue needs its own preregistration.

completion_criteria_before_writing: Frozen protocol includes arm delta, task ancestry, metric/MUE, invalid/failure rules, final artifact selection, budget, command, assessor and analysis.
Development pilot closes manipulation, contamination, stochastic variance, semantic scorer and actual runner isolation without entering confirmatory estimates.
Powered held-out family census completes with all launches, failures, retries and costs included.
Single-artifact hidden primary analysis and independent recalculation complete; no per-task archive winner substitution.
Predeclared interruption/fresh-context recovery stress and false-suppression/redundant-retry diagnostics complete.
Graph-versus-tree adoption decision is applied independent of result direction; null/inconclusive findings are preserved.
All prior invalid, not-admitted, static-only and author-reported evidence labels remain unchanged.
